newsitem.title: UK: British rock star fined for speeding.
newsitem.headline: British rock star fined for speeding.

text.p: British rock star Mark Knopfler was fined 740 pounds ($1,230) on Friday when he appeared in court for driving at more than 100 mph (160 kph), the Press Association news agency said.
The singer and guitarist of Dire Straits was caught by police speeding on a highway in southern England. He was on his way to see his children at their school, PA said.
Knopfler, 47, told the court: "I wasn't aware that I was going over 100mph." The speed limit on the road was 70 mph.
